data.title: 2B · 废弃游乐园城堡的机械烟火
data.description: 【2B · 废弃游乐园城堡的机械烟火】长满爬山虎的废弃哥特式游乐园城堡尖顶平台上，夜空不断爆开机械生命体发射的五彩缤纷节日烟火。2B 身穿浅蓝白蕾丝的清凉战斗装束，单手扶着栏杆仰望夜空。眼罩下的面容微仰，火光将她雪白的肌肤与轻柔的裙纱染上梦幻般的彩光，在这怪诞而孤独的世界中呈现出震撼人心的纯净之美。
data.location: 废弃游乐园古堡观景平台
data.action: 单手扶栏杆仰望满天机械烟火，清凉战斗服随风扬起，微仰下颌若有所思
data.lighting: 盛大璀璨烟花在夜空中爆裂的多色艳丽光晕与古堡暗色剪影
data.camera: medium shot, 3/4 low angle, vibrant night sky focus
data.promptProse: 2B watches mechanical fireworks from the ivy-covered amusement-park castle platform, one hand on the railing in her pale-blue-and-white lace combat bodysuit and matching stockings. Her bandaged arm and blindfold remain visible in the low three-quarter medium view. Colored bursts bloom over the dark castle silhouette behind. Their changing light reveals lace edges and white hair, while the unlit rail and platform provide quieter shaded layers below.
